name: Form Region Settings
description: Windows MDM settings in the Form Region Settings category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Configure form regions permissions (User)
properties.description: By default, all form region customizations are permitted to run in Outlook. By using this setting, you can disable all form region customizations, or specify that form regions must be registered on a per-computer basis, rather than a per-user basis.

enum.description: All form regions are allowed to run
Allow only those registered in HKLM
No form regions are allowed to run

properties.name: Locked form regions (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to configure adjoining form regions to be always expanded.

If you enable this policy setting, you may enter the adjoining form region name as the Value name and the Value data as "1" (without quotes). This ensures that users see the whole adjoining form region and cannot collapse it. This works for both Explorer and Inspector.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, adjoining form regions are not expanded.
